description: AI-generated illustrative scene, not a photograph of an actual client workshop.
prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: photorealistic hero illustration for a leadership-team facilitation website.
Edit target: input image 1 is the existing indoor team conversation. Edit only Max, the man seated in the middle wearing blue round glasses and a two-tone blue sweatshirt.
Identity and clothing references: inputs 2 and 3 (DSC3384 and DSC3398) show Max's actual face, hair, glasses, shoulders, chest and white sweater from two angles. Input 4 (DSC3596) is the main seated anatomy and body-proportion reference. Input 5 (DSC3810) provides the side profile and the white sweater in another seated pose. All reference photos show the SAME man. They are identity/anatomy/garment references, not background references.
Requested correction: the existing generated Max looks unnatural, particularly the relationship of his head to his body. Reconstruct his head, neck, shoulders and torso together using the real photographs. Match his actual head size relative to shoulders and torso, the natural neck length and attachment, his slender but normal build, and believable seated adult proportions. Preserve his real facial likeness and apparent age: light brown swept-up short hair, blue round glasses, light stubble, face and jaw shape as shown in the real photographs. Avoid an elongated narrow face, tiny pasted-on head, unnaturally long neck, oversized torso, or caricature. Do not merely enlarge or shrink a face cutout; make the entire person anatomically coherent.
Clothing: dress Max in the same plain white / very light off-white crewneck sweater from the reference photographs. Match its smooth fine fabric, ribbed crew neck and cuffs, regular fitted cut, sleeves naturally pushed up to the forearms and natural folds. The sweater must read as white in the room's warm daylight, not blue, grey, or chunky knit. Keep his existing trousers.
Pose and expression: retain the existing overall seated position and relaxed hands, attentive eye contact toward the woman speaking to his left, with a subtle warm expression. Adjust the pose only as needed for natural anatomy. Realistic hands, wrists and arms. No looking into the camera.
Preserve: the same four other people, their expressions and gestures, the workshop room, wooden chairs, plants, windows, warm daylight, candid conversational mood, landscape 3:2 composition, camera viewpoint, and Max's position in the frame. Do not transfer the forest backgrounds into the scene. Preserve natural photographic detail and skin texture without beauty retouching or plastic skin.
No text, labels, logos or watermarks. This is an illustrative scene, not documentation of an actual client workshop. Output an opaque landscape image.
